/* BmsCargoMapper.selectCarryIn : 반입+반입예정 조회 */ WITH cargoData AS ( SELECT TOP 1 'IN_PLAN' AS SOURCE_TYPE, 0 AS IN_NO, IN_PLAN_NO, '' AS IN_CLASS,
OD_JOB_NO, BL_NO, CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, MBL_NO, VESSEL_FLIGHT, COMMODITY_ITEM_LOC, CASE WHEN CD_TYPE = 'B' THEN '배제' WHEN CD_TYPE = 'E' THEN '이행' WHEN CD_TYPE = 'N' THEN '일반' WHEN CD_TYPE = 'Y' THEN '목록' ELSE '' END AS CD_TYPE, AMOUNT_USD, '' AS LOCATION_PLACE, '' AS INFO_LAST_CLASS, SHIPPER_NAME, SHIPPER_ADDRESS_1, SHIPPER_TEL, CONSIGNEE_NAME, CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_1, CONSIGNEE_TEL, AR_DATE + ' ' + AR_TIME AS AR_DATE_TIME, '' AS CARRY_IN_DATE_TIME, '' AS CARRY_OUT_DATE_TIME, '' AS OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME, '' AS FWD_NAME, '' AS BROKER_NAME, DELIVERY_NAME, EX_CT, 0 AS CT, 0 AS OUT_CT, 0 AS STOCK_CT, EX_WT, 0 AS WT, 0 AS OUT_WT, 0 AS STOCK_WT, '' AS XRAY_LINE_NO, ( SELECT TOP 1 xray.XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE FROM TB_BMS_XRAY_RESULT xray WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE xray.IN_PLAN_NO = _inPlan.IN_PLAN_NO ) AS XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE, SE_INSPECTION_CODE, PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE, INSPECTION_TYPE, BIG_SIZE_YN, INTELLECTUAL_PROP_YN, INSPECTION_CUSTOMS_YN, ( SELECT TOP 1 (SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'SE_INSPECTION_CODE' AND CODE = xray.XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE AND CODE NOT IN ('C') AND USE_YN='Y') AS XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE FROM TB_BMS_XRAY_RESULT xray WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE xray.IN_PLAN_NO = _inPlan.IN_PLAN_NO ) AS XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE_STR, (SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'SE_INSPECTION_CODE' AND CODE = SE_INSPECTION_CODE AND USE_YN='Y') AS SE_INSPECTION_CODE_STR, (SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'SE_INSPECTION_CODE' AND CODE = PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE AND USE_YN='Y') AS PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE_STR, (SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'INSPECTION_TYPE' AND CODE = INSPECTION_TYPE AND USE_YN='Y') AS INSPECTION_TYPE_STR, 0 AS XRAY_SCAN_CT, 0 AS XRAY_IMAGE_CT, '' AS HOLD_CODE, '' AS HOLD_REASON, '' AS HOLD_RELEASE_YN FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN _inPlan WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE 1=1
AND BL_NO = #{blNo}
AND IN_PLAN_NO = #{inPlanNo}
AND CARGO_REFERENCE_NO = #{cargoReferenceNo}
UNION ALL
SELECT TOP 1 'IN' AS SOURCE_TYPE, IN_NO, IN_PLAN_NO, IN_CLASS,
OD_JOB_NO, BL_NO, CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, MBL_NO, VESSEL_FLIGHT, COMMODITY_ITEM_LOC, CASE WHEN CD_TYPE = 'B' THEN '배제' WHEN CD_TYPE = 'E' THEN '이행' WHEN CD_TYPE = 'N' THEN '일반' WHEN CD_TYPE = 'Y' THEN '목록' ELSE '' END AS CD_TYPE, AMOUNT_USD, CASE WHEN LOCATION_PLACE = '999' THEN '로케이션 삭제' WHEN LOCATION_PLACE = 'A' THEN '일반' WHEN LOCATION_PLACE = 'A101' THEN 'A1-01 장기보관' WHEN LOCATION_PLACE = 'B' THEN '취하' WHEN LOCATION_PLACE = 'C' THEN '홀드' WHEN LOCATION_PLACE = 'C101' THEN 'C1-01' WHEN LOCATION_PLACE = 'D' THEN '수입신고수리완료' WHEN LOCATION_PLACE = 'D00101' THEN 'D0-01-01 체화' WHEN LOCATION_PLACE = 'D9-AA' THEN 'D9-AA 파손' WHEN LOCATION_PLACE = 'ETC001' THEN '기타분류위치' ELSE LOCATION_PLACE END AS LOCATION_PLACE, '' AS INFO_LAST_CLASS, SHIPPER_NAME, SHIPPER_ADDRESS_1, SHIPPER_TEL, CONSIGNEE_NAME, CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_1, CONSIGNEE_TEL, AR_DATE + ' ' + AR_TIME AS AR_DATE_TIME, CARRYIN_DATE + ' ' + CARRYIN_TIME AS CARRY_IN_DATE_TIME, '' AS CARRY_OUT_DATE_TIME, '' AS OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME, FWD_NAME, '' AS BROKER_NAME, DELIVERY_NAME, EX_CT, CT, 0 AS OUT_CT, (SELECT SUM(STOCK_CT) FROM TB_BMS_IN _sub_in WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE _sub_in.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO = _in.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO GROUP BY _sub_in.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO) AS STOCK_CT, EX_WT, WT, 0 AS OUT_WT, (SELECT SUM(STOCK_WT) FROM TB_BMS_IN _sub_in WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE _sub_in.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO = _in.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO GROUP BY _sub_in.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO) AS STOCK_WT, XRAY_LINE_NO, COALESCE(XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE, ( SELECT TOP 1 xray.XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE FROM TB_BMS_XRAY_RESULT xray WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE xray.IN_PLAN_NO = _in.IN_PLAN_NO ) ) AS XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE, SE_INSPECTION_CODE, PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE, INSPECTION_TYPE, BIG_SIZE_YN, INTELLECTUAL_PROP_YN, INSPECTION_CUSTOMS_YN, COALESCE((SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'SE_INSPECTION_CODE' AND CODE = XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE AND CODE NOT IN ('C') AND USE_YN='Y'), ( SELECT TOP 1 (SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'SE_INSPECTION_CODE' AND CODE = xray.XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE AND CODE NOT IN ('C') AND USE_YN='Y') FROM TB_BMS_XRAY_RESULT xray WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE xray.IN_PLAN_NO = _in.IN_PLAN_NO ) ) AS XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE_STR, (SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'SE_INSPECTION_CODE' AND CODE = SE_INSPECTION_CODE AND USE_YN='Y') AS SE_INSPECTION_CODE_STR, (SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'SE_INSPECTION_CODE' AND CODE = PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE AND USE_YN='Y') AS PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE_STR, (SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'INSPECTION_TYPE' AND CODE = INSPECTION_TYPE AND USE_YN='Y') AS INSPECTION_TYPE_STR, XRAY_SCAN_CT, XRAY_IMAGE_CT, '' AS HOLD_CODE, '' AS HOLD_REASON, '' AS HOLD_RELEASE_YN FROM TB_BMS_IN _in WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE 1=1
AND BL_NO = #{blNo}
AND IN_PLAN_NO = #{inPlanNo}
AND CARGO_REFERENCE_NO = #{cargoReferenceNo}
)
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN NULLIF(IN_NO, '') END) AS IN_NO, COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN NULLIF(IN_PLAN_NO, '') END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN_PLAN' THEN NULLIF(IN_PLAN_NO, '') END), '' ) AS IN_PLAN_NO,
MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN NULLIF(IN_CLASS, '') END) AS IN_CLASS,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN NULLIF(OD_JOB_NO, '') END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN_PLAN' THEN NULLIF(OD_JOB_NO, '') END), '' ) AS OD_JOB_NO,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN NULLIF(BL_NO, '') END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN_PLAN' THEN NULLIF(BL_NO, '') END), '' ) AS BL_NO,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN NULLIF(CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, '') END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN_PLAN' THEN NULLIF(CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, '') END), '' ) AS CARGO_REFERENCE_NO,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN NULLIF(MBL_NO, '') END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN_PLAN' THEN NULLIF(MBL_NO, '') END), '' ) AS MBL_NO,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN NULLIF(VESSEL_FLIGHT, '') END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN_PLAN' THEN NULLIF(VESSEL_FLIGHT, '') END), '' ) AS VESSEL_FLIGHT,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN NULLIF(COMMODITY_ITEM_LOC, '') END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN_PLAN' THEN NULLIF(COMMODITY_ITEM_LOC, '') END), '' ) AS COMMODITY_ITEM_LOC,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN NULLIF(CD_TYPE, '') END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN_PLAN' THEN NULLIF(CD_TYPE, '') END), '' ) AS CD_TYPE,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN AMOUNT_USD END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN_PLAN' THEN AMOUNT_USD END), 0 ) AS AMOUNT_USD,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN NULLIF(LOCATION_PLACE, '') END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN_PLAN' THEN NULLIF(LOCATION_PLACE, '') END), '' ) AS LOCATION_PLACE,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN NULLIF(SHIPPER_NAME, '') END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN_PLAN' THEN NULLIF(SHIPPER_NAME, '') END), '' ) AS SHIPPER_NAME,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN NULLIF(SHIPPER_ADDRESS_1, '') END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN_PLAN' THEN NULLIF(SHIPPER_ADDRESS_1, '') END), '' ) AS SHIPPER_ADDRESS_1,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN dbo.Cryptography(OD_JOB_NO, NULLIF(SHIPPER_TEL, ''), 1) END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN_PLAN' THEN dbo.Cryptography(OD_JOB_NO, NULLIF(SHIPPER_TEL, ''), 1) END), '' ) AS SHIPPER_TEL,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN NULLIF(CONSIGNEE_NAME, '') END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN_PLAN' THEN NULLIF(CONSIGNEE_NAME, '') END), '' ) AS CONSIGNEE_NAME,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN NULLIF(CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_1, '') END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN_PLAN' THEN NULLIF(CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_1, '') END), '' ) AS CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_1,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN dbo.Cryptography(OD_JOB_NO, NULLIF(CONSIGNEE_TEL, ''), 1) END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN_PLAN' THEN dbo.Cryptography(OD_JOB_NO, NULLIF(CONSIGNEE_TEL, ''), 1) END), '' ) AS CONSIGNEE_TEL,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN NULLIF(AR_DATE_TIME, '') END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN_PLAN' THEN NULLIF(AR_DATE_TIME, '') END), '' ) AS AR_DATE_TIME,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN NULLIF(CARRY_IN_DATE_TIME, '') END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN_PLAN' THEN NULLIF(CARRY_IN_DATE_TIME, '') END), '' ) AS CARRY_IN_DATE_TIME,
MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN NULLIF(FWD_NAME, '') END) AS FWD_NAME,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN NULLIF(DELIVERY_NAME, '') END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN_PLAN' THEN NULLIF(DELIVERY_NAME, '') END), '' ) AS DELIVERY_NAME,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN_PLAN' THEN XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE END), '' ) AS XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN SE_INSPECTION_CODE END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN_PLAN' THEN SE_INSPECTION_CODE END), '' ) AS SE_INSPECTION_CODE,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN_PLAN' THEN PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE END), '' ) AS PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN INSPECTION_TYPE END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN_PLAN' THEN INSPECTION_TYPE END), '' ) AS INSPECTION_TYPE,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE_STR END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN_PLAN' THEN XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE_STR END), '' ) AS XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE_STR,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN SE_INSPECTION_CODE_STR END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN_PLAN' THEN SE_INSPECTION_CODE_STR END), '' ) AS SE_INSPECTION_CODE_STR,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE_STR END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN_PLAN' THEN PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE_STR END), '' ) AS PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE_STR,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN INSPECTION_TYPE_STR END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN_PLAN' THEN INSPECTION_TYPE_STR END), '' ) AS INSPECTION_TYPE_STR,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN BIG_SIZE_YN END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN_PLAN' THEN BIG_SIZE_YN END), '' ) AS BIG_SIZE_YN,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN INTELLECTUAL_PROP_YN END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN_PLAN' THEN INTELLECTUAL_PROP_YN END), '' ) AS INTELLECTUAL_PROP_YN,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN INSPECTION_CUSTOMS_YN END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN_PLAN' THEN INSPECTION_CUSTOMS_YN END), '' ) AS INSPECTION_CUSTOMS_YN,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN EX_CT END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN_PLAN' THEN EX_CT END), 0 ) AS EX_CT,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN CT END), 0 ) AS CT,
MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN STOCK_CT END) AS STOCK_CT,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN EX_WT END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN_PLAN' THEN EX_WT END), 0 ) AS EX_WT,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN WT END), 0 ) AS WT,
MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'IN' THEN STOCK_WT END) AS STOCK_WT
FROM cargoData GROUP BY BL_NO;

/* BmsCargoMapper.selectCarryOut : 반출+반출승인 조회 */ WITH cargoData AS ( SELECT 'OUT_PLAN' AS SOURCE_TYPE, IN_NO,
0 AS OUT_NO, OUT_PLAN_NO, '' AS OUT_APPROVAL_NO, '' AS APPROVAL_CLASS, OUT_CLASS, '' AS CUSTOMER_CODE, '' AS CUSTOMER_NAME, COMPANY_BUSINESS_NO, COMPANY_NAME, '' AS OD_JOB_NO, BL_NO, CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, MBL_NO, VESSEL_FLIGHT, '' AS COMMODITY_ITEM_LOC, '' AS CD_TYPE, 0 AS AMOUNT_USD, '' AS LOCATION_PLACE, '' AS INFO_LAST_CLASS, '' AS SHIPPER_NAME, '' AS SHIPPER_ADDRESS_1, '' AS SHIPPER_TEL, '' AS CONSIGNEE_NAME, '' AS CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_1, '' AS CONSIGNEE_TEL, '' AS AR_DATE_TIME, '' AS CARRY_IN_DATE_TIME, '' AS CARRY_OUT_DATE_TIME, OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME, '' AS FWD_NAME, '' AS BROKER_NAME, '' AS DELIVERY_NAME, 0 AS EX_CT, 0 AS CT, 0 AS OUT_CT, 0 AS STOCK_CT, 0 AS EX_WT, 0 AS WT, 0 AS OUT_WT, 0 AS STOCK_WT, '' AS XRAY_LINE_NO, '' AS XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE, '' AS SE_INSPECTION_CODE, '' AS PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE, '' AS INSPECTION_TYPE, '' AS BIG_SIZE_YN, '' AS INTELLECTUAL_PROP_YN, '' AS INSPECTION_CUSTOMS_YN, 0 AS XRAY_SCAN_CT, 0 AS XRAY_IMAGE_CT, '' AS HOLD_CODE, '' AS HOLD_REASON, '' AS HOLD_RELEASE_YN FROM TB_BMS_OUT_PLAN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE IN_NO = #{inNo}
UNION ALL
SELECT 'OUT' AS SOURCE_TYPE, IN_NO,
OUT_NO, OUT_PLAN_NO, OUT_APPROVAL_NO, '' AS APPROVAL_CLASS, OUT_CLASS, CUSTOMER_CODE, CUSTOMER_NAME, '' AS COMPANY_BUSINESS_NO, '' AS COMPANY_NAME, OD_JOB_NO, BL_NO, CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, MBL_NO, '' AS VESSEL_FLIGHT, '' AS COMMODITY_ITEM_LOC, '' AS CD_TYPE, 0 AS AMOUNT_USD, '' AS LOCATION_PLACE, '' AS INFO_LAST_CLASS, '' AS SHIPPER_NAME, '' AS SHIPPER_ADDRESS_1, '' AS SHIPPER_TEL, '' AS CONSIGNEE_NAME, '' AS CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_1, '' AS CONSIGNEE_TEL, '' AS AR_DATE_TIME, '' AS CARRY_IN_DATE_TIME, CARRYOUT_DATE + ' ' + CARRYOUT_TIME AS CARRY_OUT_DATE_TIME, OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME, '' AS FWD_NAME, BROKER_NAME, '' AS DELIVERY_NAME, 0 AS EX_CT, 0 AS CT, OUT_CT, 0 AS STOCK_CT, 0 AS EX_WT, 0 AS WT, OUT_WT, 0 AS STOCK_WT, '' AS XRAY_LINE_NO, '' AS XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE, '' AS SE_INSPECTION_CODE, '' AS PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE, '' AS INSPECTION_TYPE, '' AS BIG_SIZE_YN, '' AS INTELLECTUAL_PROP_YN, '' AS INSPECTION_CUSTOMS_YN, 0 AS XRAY_SCAN_CT, 0 AS XRAY_IMAGE_CT, '' AS HOLD_CODE, '' AS HOLD_REASON, '' AS HOLD_RELEASE_YN FROM TB_BMS_OUT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE IN_NO = #{inNo} )
SELECT COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'OUT' THEN NULLIF(IN_NO, '') END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'OUT_PLAN' THEN NULLIF(IN_NO, '') END), '' ) AS IN_NO,
MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'OUT' THEN NULLIF(OUT_NO, '') END) AS OUT_NO, MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'OUT_PLAN' THEN NULLIF(OUT_PLAN_NO, '') END) AS OUT_PLAN_NO,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'OUT' THEN NULLIF(OUT_APPROVAL_NO, '') END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'OUT_PLAN' THEN NULLIF(OUT_APPROVAL_NO, '') END), '' ) AS OUT_APPROVAL_NO,
MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'OUT_PLAN' THEN NULLIF(APPROVAL_CLASS, '') END) AS APPROVAL_CLASS,
MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'OUT' THEN NULLIF(CUSTOMER_CODE, '') END) AS CUSTOMER_CODE, MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'OU' THEN NULLIF(CUSTOMER_NAME, '') END) AS CUSTOMER_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'OUT_PLAN' THEN NULLIF(COMPANY_BUSINESS_NO, '') END) AS COMPANY_BUSINESS_NO, MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'OUT_PLAN' THEN NULLIF(COMPANY_NAME, '') END) AS COMPANY_NAME,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'OUT' THEN NULLIF(OUT_CLASS, '') END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'OUT_PLAN' THEN NULLIF(OUT_CLASS, '') END), '' ) AS OUT_CLASS,
MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'OUT' THEN NULLIF(OD_JOB_NO, '') END) AS OD_JOB_NO,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'OUT' THEN NULLIF(BL_NO, '') END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'OUT_PLAN' THEN NULLIF(BL_NO, '') END), '' ) AS BL_NO,
CARGO_REFERENCE_NO,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'OUT' THEN NULLIF(MBL_NO, '') END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'OUT_PLAN' THEN NULLIF(MBL_NO, '') END), '' ) AS MBL_NO,
MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'OUT_PLAN' THEN NULLIF(VESSEL_FLIGHT, '') END) AS VESSEL_FLIGHT,
MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'OUT' THEN NULLIF(CARRY_OUT_DATE_TIME, '') END) AS CARRY_OUT_DATE_TIME,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'OUT' THEN NULLIF(OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME, '') END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'OUT_PLAN' THEN NULLIF(OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME, '') END), '' ) AS OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME,
MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'OUT' THEN NULLIF(BROKER_NAME, '') END) AS BROKER_NAME,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'OUT' THEN OUT_CT END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'OUT_PLAN' THEN OUT_CT END), 0 ) AS OUT_CT,
COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'OUT' THEN OUT_WT END), MAX(CASE WHEN SOURCE_TYPE = 'OUT_PLAN' THEN OUT_WT END), 0 ) AS OUT_WT
FROM cargoData GROUP BY CARGO_REFERENCE_NO;
/* BmsCargoMapper.selectOutList : 반출 조회 */ SELECT * FROM TB_BMS_OUT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE IN_NO IN (#{item.inNo})
/* BmsCargoMapper.selectOutPlanList : 반출 승인 조회 */ SELECT * FROM TB_BMS_OUT_PLAN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE IN_NO IN (#{item.inNo})

/* BmsCargoMapper.selectHoldInfo : 화물조회 홀드 정보 조회 */ SELECT ISNULL((SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE CODE = MAX(HOLD_CODE) AND ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND GROUP_CODE='HOLD_CODE' AND USE_YN='Y'), '') AS HOLD_CODE, MAX(HOLD_REASON) AS HOLD_REASON, MAX(HOLD_RELEASE_YN) AS HOLD_RELEASE_YN FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} GROUP BY OD_JOB_NO

/* BmsCargoMapper.selectInspectResultCompleteByInNoAndType : 반입번호로 검사 완료 검사결과 조회 */ SELECT TOP 1 * FROM TB_BMS_INSPECT_RESULT WHERE IN_NO = #{inNo} AND INSPECTION_FINISH_YN = 'Y' AND INSPECTION_TYPE LIKE #{inspectionType} + '%' ORDER BY INSPECTION_FINISH_DATE_TIME DESC

/* BmsCargoMapper.selectXray : 화물 조회 - XRAY판독결과 조회 */ SELECT TOP 1 XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE, XRAY_LINE_NO, XRAY_SCAN_CT, XRAY_IMAGE_CT, XRAY_TIME, INSPECTOR_ID FROM TB_BMS_XRAY_RESULT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE IN_PLAN_NO = #{inPlanNo}

/* BmsCargoMapper.selectXrayPassTimeByPkgNo : 화물 조회 - 판독 일시 조회 */ SELECT TOP 1 REGISTER_DATE_TIME AS XRAY_PASS_TIME FROM TB_BMS_XRAY_HISTORY WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE PACKING_NO = #{packingNo} ORDER BY REGISTER_DATE_TIME DESC

/* BmsCargoMapper.selectSortHistoryMsg : 화물 조회 - 분류 메세지 조회 */ SELECT TOP 1 CASE WHEN OUT_RSN_CD = '1' THEN SRT_TYPE_NM ELSE OUT_RSN_NM END AS SRT_TYPE_NM FROM TB_BMS_SORT_RESULT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE HBL_NO = #{blNo} AND BOX_ID <> '' ORDER BY REGISTER_DATE_TIME DESC

/* BmsCargoMapper.selectXrayPassTime : 화물 조회 - 판독 일시 조회 */ SELECT TOP 1 REGISTER_DATE_TIME AS XRAY_PASS_TIME FROM TB_BMS_XRAY_HISTORY WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE IN_PLAN_NO = #{inPlanNo} ORDER BY REGISTER_DATE_TIME DESC

/* BmsCargoMapper.selectCargoInOutHistory : 화물 조회 - 화물 반출입 내역 조회 */ WITH targetIn AS ( SELECT i.IN_NO, i.IN_PLAN_NO, i.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, i.LAST_POD_RAQ_DATE, i.REGISTER_DATE_TIME, i.IN_CLASS, i.CT, i.WT, i.CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO, i.IN_APPROVAL_NO, i.LAST_POD_STATUS FROM TB_BMS_IN i WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE i.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO = #{cargoReferenceNo} ), cargoHistory AS ( /* * 기존 inCargo의 의미를 보존한다. * 실제 반입이 하나라도 있으면 IN_PLAN 대신 모든 IN 행을 반환하고, * 아직 실제 반입이 없을 때만 IN_PLAN 한 행을 반환한다. */ SELECT 'IN_PLAN' AS SOURCE_TYPE, p.NOTIFY_DATE_TIME AS STATUS_DATE_TIME, p.REGISTER_DATE_TIME, p.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, CAST(NULL AS int) AS IN_NO, p.IN_PLAN_NO, CAST(NULL AS int) AS OUT_PLAN_NO, CAST(NULL AS int) AS OUT_NO, '' AS STATUS_CLASS, p.EX_CT AS CT, p.EX_WT AS WT, '' AS CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO, p.IN_APPROVAL_NO AS APPROVAL_NO, CAST('' AS varchar(6)) AS LAST_POD_STATUS FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN p WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE p.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO = #{cargoReferenceNo} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM targetIn)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'IN' AS SOURCE_TYPE, CASE WHEN i.LAST_POD_RAQ_DATE = '1900-01-01' THEN i.REGISTER_DATE_TIME ELSE i.LAST_POD_RAQ_DATE END AS STATUS_DATE_TIME, i.REGISTER_DATE_TIME, i.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, i.IN_NO, i.IN_PLAN_NO, CAST(NULL AS int) AS OUT_PLAN_NO, CAST(NULL AS int) AS OUT_NO, i.IN_CLASS AS STATUS_CLASS, i.CT, i.WT, i.CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO, i.IN_APPROVAL_NO AS APPROVAL_NO, i.LAST_POD_STATUS AS reportStatus FROM targetIn i
UNION ALL
/* * OUT_PLAN은 다른 유사 컬럼이 아니라 TB_BMS_IN.IN_NO로만 연결한다. * OUT_CLASS='31'인데 아직 TB_BMS_OUT이 없어도 이 행은 그대로 남는다. * OUT_CLASS='1'(취하)도 이력으로 반환한다. */ SELECT 'OUT_PLAN' AS SOURCE_TYPE, op.NOTIFY_DATE_TIME AS STATUS_DATE_TIME, op.REGISTER_DATE_TIME, op.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, op.IN_NO, i.IN_PLAN_NO AS IN_PLAN_NO, op.OUT_PLAN_NO, CAST(NULL AS int) AS OUT_NO, op.OUT_CLASS AS STATUS_CLASS, op.APPROVAL_CT AS CT, op.APPROVAL_WT AS WT, '' AS CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO, op.OUT_APPROVAL_NO AS APPROVAL_NO, op.APPROVAL_CLASS AS LAST_POD_STATUS FROM targetIn i INNER JOIN TB_BMS_OUT_PLAN op WITH (NOLOCK) ON op.IN_NO = i.IN_NO
UNION ALL
SELECT 'OUT' AS SOURCE_TYPE, CASE WHEN o.LAST_POD_RAQ_DATE = '1900-01-01' THEN o.REGISTER_DATE_TIME ELSE o.LAST_POD_RAQ_DATE END AS STATUS_DATE_TIME, o.REGISTER_DATE_TIME, o.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, o.IN_NO, i.IN_PLAN_NO AS IN_PLAN_NO, o.OUT_PLAN_NO, o.OUT_NO, o.OUT_CLASS AS STATUS_CLASS, o.OUT_CT AS CT, o.OUT_WT AS WT, o.CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO, o.OUT_APPROVAL_NO AS APPROVAL_NO, o.LAST_POD_STATUS AS LAST_POD_STATUS FROM targetIn i INNER JOIN TB_BMS_OUT o WITH (NOLOCK) ON o.IN_NO = i.IN_NO ) SELECT SOURCE_TYPE, STATUS_DATE_TIME, REGISTER_DATE_TIME, CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, IN_NO, IN_PLAN_NO, OUT_PLAN_NO, OUT_NO, STATUS_CLASS, CT, WT, CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO, APPROVAL_NO, LAST_POD_STATUS FROM cargoHistory ORDER BY STATUS_DATE_TIME DESC, REGISTER_DATE_TIME DESC
